note: Prices shown are indicative and taken from current delivery listings. Final menu and prices to be confirmed with the restaurant.

sections.title: Small plates & grill
sections.intro: Start with something from the charcoal grill. Our suya is cut thin, dusted with yaji spice and finished over open flame.

items.name: Beef Suya
items.desc: Thin-sliced beef, house yaji peanut and chilli rub, charcoal grilled. Served with raw onion and tomato.

items.name: Chicken Suya
items.desc: Chicken thigh in the same smoky yaji rub, grilled until the edges char.

items.name: Asun
items.desc: Peppered goat, chopped and tossed in a hot pepper and onion sauce. A Lagos party classic.

items.name: Peppered Gizzard
items.desc: Slow-cooked gizzard in a rich red pepper sauce.

items.name: Moin Moin
items.desc: Steamed black-eyed bean pudding with peppers and onion. Soft, savoury and naturally gluten free.

items.name: Puff Puff
items.desc: Light, lightly sweet fried dough balls. Six pieces.

sections.title: Pepper soups
sections.intro: Light, aromatic broths built on a blend of native spices. The dish Nigerians reach for when it is cold outside.

items.name: Goat Pepper Soup
items.desc: Tender goat in a clear, fragrant broth of calabash nutmeg, uziza and chilli.

items.name: Catfish Pepper Soup
items.desc: Fresh catfish steaks simmered gently in spiced broth.

items.name: Assorted Meat Pepper Soup
items.desc: A mix of beef, tripe and offal for the adventurous.

sections.title: Rice
sections.intro: Every plate comes with your choice of protein. Add fried plantain, because you should.

items.name: Jollof Rice
items.desc: Long-grain rice cooked down in a smoky tomato and pepper base with a hint of ginger and star anise. Two pieces of meat.

items.name: Ofada Rice & Ayamase
items.desc: Nutty local brown rice with our dark green pepper stew of bell peppers, palm oil and assorted meats.

items.name: Nigerian Fried Rice
items.desc: Rice tossed with mixed vegetables, liver and shrimp. Two pieces of meat.

items.name: Rice & Beans
items.desc: Rice and honey beans cooked together, served with stew and two pieces of meat.

items.name: White Rice & Stew
items.desc: Plain rice with our slow-cooked red stew. Two pieces of meat.

sections.title: Soups & swallows
sections.intro: Choose a swallow, choose a soup, eat with your hands if you like. New to this? Ask us and we'll walk you through it.

items.name: Egusi
items.desc: Ground melon seed soup with spinach, palm oil and assorted meats. The one everyone starts with.

items.name: Efo Riro
items.desc: Rich spinach stew with peppers, locust beans and assorted meat and fish.

items.name: Abula (Ewedu & Gbegiri)
items.desc: Jute leaf soup and bean soup served together over stew. The classic Ibadan pairing with amala.

items.name: Ogbono
items.desc: Silky wild mango seed soup with assorted meats.

items.name: Okra Soup
items.desc: Fresh okra, fish and meat in a light palm oil broth.

sections.title: Fish & grills
sections.intro: Whole fish, seasoned and grilled to order. Allow 20 minutes.

items.name: Eja Tutu
items.desc: Whole grilled tilapia in a pepper marinade, served with fried plantain and a side of your choice.

items.name: Grilled Croaker
items.desc: Whole croaker, charred and spiced, with onion and tomato salad.

items.name: Grilled Chicken
items.desc: Half chicken in a smoky pepper glaze. Served with jollof or fries.

items.name: Chapman
items.desc: Nigeria's house cocktail: grenadine, citrus, bitters, Fanta and Sprite. Non-alcoholic.

items.name: Zobo
items.desc: Chilled hibiscus with ginger and pineapple.
